name: Test: the held item copy keeps the mod instances
author: test
summary: Holds a ModItem with a counter and checks that Player.lastVisualizedSelectedItem gets a fresh ModItem and GlobalItem copy every update, while the Player.clientClone copies do not.
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh csvisualclone. Run with tools/tests/run-cs.sh csvisualclone. Logs csvisualclone <case>: ok | FAIL and csvisualclone END.
